Name: SimpleMute
Author: Anam Ahmed

Actions.Name: Mute
Actions.Tooltip: One mute key. Detects the meeting running in your browser and mutes or unmutes your microphone. With no meeting open it mutes the system's default input (macOS). The key shows live state and which app it controls.

Actions.Name: Camera
Actions.Tooltip: Detects the meeting running in your browser and turns your camera on or off. The key shows live state.

Actions.Name: Share Screen
Actions.Tooltip: Stops an active screen share, or opens the meeting's share control. The key shows whether you are sharing.

Actions.Name: Leave Meeting
Actions.Tooltip: Leaves the meeting running in your browser. Single press, no confirmation.

Description: One mute key for every browser-based meeting. SimpleMute detects the meeting running in your browser and mutes or unmutes it, with keys that show live on/off state. Requires the SimpleMute browser extension.
